test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the part that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

That was a good / conversation, I look forward / to meet you.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'to meet you.'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** error in the **sentence is related to the use of the infinitive** 'to meet'.**
 
• When the phrase **'look forward to'** is used,** it should be followed by a gerund **(-ing form of a verb) and not an infinitive.

Therefore, the **correct form **of the sentence is:* "That was a good conversation, I look forward to **meeting you."***
